info.name: Weather Tracker API
info.description: REST API for tracking weather forecasts and observations for 38 cities. Built with Flask and MongoDB. Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/v1`. Write operations need a Bearer token from `/auth/login`. Admin-only routes return 403 for normal users. Test accounts alice, bob and carol use the password `password123` (test data only).
